column1: 本应用是一款面向日常血糖记录、饮食管理和健康趋势查看的辅助工具，不属于医疗器械，也不提供疾病诊断、治疗方案、处方开具或替代医生诊疗等医疗服务。
column2: This app supports daily glucose logging, meal management and health-trend review. It is not a medical device and does not diagnose disease, provide treatment plans or prescriptions, or replace medical care.

column1: 应用展示的 AI 识别结果、血糖趋势、风险提示、饮食分析、营养建议及问答内容，均由算法依据用户提交的信息生成，仅供个人健康管理参考，不应作为自行调整药物、胰岛素剂量或治疗方案的依据。
column2: AI recognition, glucose trends, risk alerts, meal analysis, nutrition suggestions and answers are generated from information you submit. They are for personal health reference only. Do not use them to change medication, insulin doses or treatment on your own.

column1: 拍照识别可能受到光线、角度、清晰度、设备型号、试纸显示效果及网络状态等因素影响，可能出现数值或时段识别错误。每次保存前，请务必由本人核对血糖值、记录日期和所属时段。
column2: Photo recognition can be affected by lighting, angle, clarity, device model, display and network conditions, and may misread values or time slots. Check the glucose value, date and time slot yourself before every save.

column1: 血糖仪、动态血糖监测设备与本应用之间可能存在测量或同步差异。如应用记录与实际设备读数不一致，应以合格设备的原始读数及专业医务人员意见为准。
column2: Measurements and synchronisation may differ between this app, glucose meters and continuous monitors. If records disagree, rely on the original reading from a qualified device and advice from a healthcare professional.

column1: 用户应如实填写年龄、糖尿病类型、用药情况、运动习惯及其他健康资料。资料缺失、不准确或未及时更新，可能影响统计结果和个性化建议的准确性。
column2: Provide accurate and current age, diabetes type, medication, exercise and other health details. Missing, inaccurate or outdated information may affect statistics and personalised suggestions.

column1: 用户上传或填写的头像、血糖、饮食、健康档案和反馈等信息，将在实现账户服务、数据同步、趋势分析和功能改进所必需的范围内进行处理，并按照适用的隐私保护要求采取合理安全措施。
column2: Uploaded avatars, glucose, meal records, health information and feedback are processed as needed for account services, synchronisation, trend analysis and improvements, with reasonable safeguards under applicable privacy requirements.

column1: 请妥善保管登录设备、验证码及账户信息，不要在公共设备上长期保留登录状态。因用户主动共享账户、设备遗失或未及时退出登录造成的信息泄露风险，由用户及时联系服务方协助处理。
column2: Protect your device, verification codes and account details. Do not stay logged in on shared devices. Contact the service provider promptly for help if account sharing, a lost device or an active session exposes your information.

column1: 受网络中断、服务器维护、第三方服务异常、设备兼容性等因素影响，部分功能可能暂时不可用或出现数据延迟。重要健康数据建议同时保留血糖仪记录、纸质记录或其他可靠备份。
column2: Network outages, server maintenance, third-party failures or device compatibility may cause temporary unavailability or delays. Keep important health data in your meter, on paper or in another reliable backup as well.

column1: 若出现严重低血糖或高血糖症状、意识异常、呼吸困难、持续呕吐等紧急情况，请立即停止依赖本应用，及时联系急救机构或前往医疗机构就诊。
column2: For emergencies such as severe low- or high-glucose symptoms, altered consciousness, difficulty breathing or persistent vomiting, stop relying on this app and contact emergency services or seek urgent medical care.

column1: 未成年人、孕妇、老年人以及患有严重基础疾病的用户，应在监护人或专业医务人员指导下使用本应用，不应仅依据应用结果作出健康或治疗决定。
column2: Minors, pregnant people, older adults and people with serious underlying conditions should use this app with a guardian or healthcare professional. Do not base health or treatment decisions solely on app results.
